title: Great tapas. Come hungry!
text: We enjoyed our tapas tour with Montse. Learned a lot about the local architecture and local tapas scene. We tried 5-6 dishes at 2 restaurants. Way more food than we could eat. Montse recommended a delicious traditional Catalan dessert that left us wishing we had ordered 2. Would we go again? YES!

title: Great tapas with a local expert
text:
This was a great walking tour with an incredibly knowledgeable guide- Montse. 
She ensured we had the best of everything at the restaurants that we visited. She also sent us with a list of things to do and see in the local area. Lots of fun!
author: LagunaKendi

title: Architecture and Tapas
text: Lovely experience! My husband and I had a personalized tour by Montse,  who highlighted the splendid modernist architecture in the neighborhood of La Pedrera. She also brought us to two excellent restaurants to experience a variety of delicious tapas dishes. Hearing about the history of the restaurants was also very interesting.    Highly recommend her tour!
author: W4765AVsl

title: Private tapas tour in Modernist Barcelona
text: Montse was a superb guide, very friendly and engaging. She has a wealth of knowledge as she shared the history of Barcelona and its architecture. The tapas stops were fantastic, gave a nice blend of traditional and modern tapas experiences. She took us to some hidden gem spots were we were able to step into the buildings interior to see the stained glass and architectural features. She also provided us with some great recommendations for roof top views, restaurants and wine. Would highly recommend this tour with Montse.

title: Exceptional Foods with local history
text: Montse our guide for the evening was great! She was fun and well informed. She pointed out all the details of the buildings as we passed them. She even went as far as to ask the resident security guard for permission to go inside some of the foyers. We went to two locations. One was older style restaurant and the other was newer and modern. Trying different types of foods from Barcelona was exceptional thanks again Montse. For great memories and full bellies.
author: Companion15271

title: Had a blast
text: We had a blast with Montse last evening. A more informative and passionate guide for Barcelona could not be found. She does not take No for an answer if it will make her tour better for the customer. We saw so much, learned so much, and ate so much. We highly recommend this tour and this guide.

title: Tapas tour
